title: Delete Node in a BST
description: Given a root node reference of a BST and a key, delete the node with the given key in the BST. Return the root node reference of the (possibly updated) BST.

interfaces.name: deleteNode
interfaces.signature: def deleteNode(self, root: Optional[TreeNode], key: int) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
